title: Deactivating an account a category row uses is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure AccountingHub is enabled for the organization and the test location has no QuickBooks Online connection.
  • Make sure "No Charge: Goodwill" is mapped to 6430 Warranty & Goodwill Expense.
custom_steps:
1. Open Accounting's chart of accounts.
  2. Deactivate 6430 Warranty & Goodwill Expense.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The chart opens.

Step 2:

  • The deactivation is refused with a message naming "category mapping 'No Charge: Goodwill'".
